review.reviewer: Claude, maintainer-authorized source and dependency review (AF-CTR-04 delegated author, M review round); PR review is recorded separately
review.rationale: AF-CTR-04 part M, review round of Cloud #141 (the mobile native authorization in the center, MobileNativeAuth v1, cohort 1.0.0-ci.430.1), tested MOCKED (a virtual passkey on the account side; center/cmd/mobile-probe, a development stand-in for the Android app excluded from the image, on the app side), with the mobile surface enabled on the acceptance environment only, there with a labelled non-shipping test app statement, and dark in production: the successor of the admission at cloud-release-r88. The Go sources of the center change: the decision refuses when the center-defined operation identity.authorizeMobile is missing (fail closed); the review and the decision admit only a cookie session of scope account and purpose authenticate; a review that shows a foreign or revoked installation is counted in mobile_approve_account (and its metric pair review/rate_limited); ARCFORGES_CENTER_ANDROID_APP requires the end of the document after the array and a testOnly of exactly true; comments of the operation table, the done page and the surface defaults. The Worker sources are unchanged; the Worker record follows the new profile. The tests, mobile-probe, center/internal/mobiletest, the vendored Contracts vectors and the documents are not part of the image or the bundle. No Go module, npm package, base image, toolchain or legal file changes. It supersedes the admission at cloud-release-r88.
